name: obsidian-vault-manager
description: Obsidian vault knowledge management plugin: agents and skills for note creation, MOC management, project tracking, inbox review (4-phase SCAN→PROPOSE→CONFIRM→EXECUTE pipeline with audit-state caching for ≥3x token reduction and ≤3 user interactions), project archiving, note↔project bidirectional binding, plus reusable shell primitives (ovm-primitives.sh) for frontmatter scanning, wikilink extraction, and audit-state tracking.
